protocol.authorization: User correction: independent C-NBI versus VRF-NBI, then NSGA-III, then MOEA/D; never a joint four-method cardinality
protocol.barrier: all 135 blocks of one pair finish before the next comparator starts
protocol.K: min(N_ND_C-NBI, N_ND_comparator) independently per scenario-replica; other methods do not enter
protocol.selection: unchanged analytical normalization, objective-order forced unique minima then Phase10C FPS; first original raw ID breaks exact ties
protocol.small_K: if forced extrema exceed K, first K objective-order extrema; no artificial increase
protocol.statistical_unit: median of all five paired replicas per structural scenario
protocol.main_pair_quality_family: six two-sided exact conditional Wilcoxon tests: three pairs times IGD/HV, jointly Holm; secondary analysis in observed fixed design
protocol.native_pair_baseline_family: separate six-hypothesis Holm family using the same two methods and pair-specific numerical validity; original four-method native primary14 unchanged
protocol.secondary_density_family: nine paired tests, three pairs times GD/Spacing/Sparsity, jointly Holm; exploratory

bootstrap.method: pointwise percentile stability interval of median paired scenario differences

protocol.HV_validity: a cell is valid only when all five replicas of both methods pass original precision statuses; no exclusion caused by a third method
protocol.HV_supplement: existing higher-resolution estimates may be reused only after exact original normalized-point-set identity is verified, in a separately labelled sensitivity; official statuses unchanged
protocol.reuse: reuse verified previous/native metrics only for exactly identical selected raw-point sets; otherwise unchanged Phase10C evaluator
